findings: Lawn Care saved deadline was 6 October 17:41 UTC. Evaluator imposed an additional trust delay after explicit approval.
RESOLVED: PR 1370 deployed; natural hourly processor released once at 15:00:10 UTC on 7 October, one 50p credit verified.
Weekly payout lacks durable pre-transfer journal

Pending balance is zeroed and lifetime paid increased before Stripe call. Crash before call can strand funds. Lost success response enters restore path; weekly idempotency key later changes. Restore uses read-then-write without concurrency guard.

Persist stable payout reservation/operation; reconcile uncertain provider result; atomic recovery. Test crash, timeout, new-credit and week-boundary cases. Confirmed code risk, not exercised with real money.
Deletion can erase unpaid contractor balance

API excludes completed escrow from blockers and never checks pending payout balance. Production deletion functions delete profile; payout balance FK cascades. A contractor with only released-but-unpaid earnings can lose the balance.
api/user/delete-account/route.ts; production delete_user_data and payout FK
Block or safely settle/journal pending balance atomically; retain required financial records. No account deleted during audit.
Daily retention-cleanup failed; deployed route calls run_retention_cleanup, absent from production pg_proc.
Review/deploy matching retention migration and verify scheduled category results. Local implementation is not deployed evidence.
24 escrow cron runs marked success contain 24 item errors in 24 hours. Recurring-job-creator success has one error and no job created. Payout balance query failure returns zero failed items.
Represent partial failure and alert on overdue/failed operations with identifiers.
Displayed fee/net differs from actual deduction

Shared quote helper omits 50p minimum. Actual service applies it: £1.20 at 5% can show £1.14 net but credits £0.70. Contractor page says within 24h, and handles released but not completed accumulation correctly.
Use authoritative fee quote and actual ledger amounts; explain minimum; distinguish queued earnings from Stripe transfer. Do not silently alter pricing policy.

Mobile describes seven-day automatic window; evaluator retains trust delay. Status API blocker list lacks all dispute/risk/trust conditions.

Five completed jobs include held, pending, failed and missing escrows. Drain job payment_status remains pending despite 70p credit. Lawn paid means funded, not bank-paid.
